source.extras: inputs/oms000-jenis-produk/extras/oms000-jenis-produk.xlsx (5 sheet: Shipper - TMS vs OMS, Vendor - TMS vs OMS, Pengaturan Sistem - TMS vs OMS, Jenis Pengiriman - TMS vs OMS, TMS LKL)

assertionRules.credentials: ASM-03 — admin key & clientId dari env (${ADMIN_KEY}, ${CLIENT_ID}); DILARANG hard-code
assertionRules.suiteIsolation: ASM-38 — entitlement global per clientId; jalankan serial (workers:1) atau clientId per worker; teardown ke nilai semula
assertionRules.driverAppVerification: ASM-29 — verifikasi masuk/tidak masuk apps lewat API daftar tugas sopir GET .../driver/{driverId}/assignments -> $.data[]; fallback push-log/timeline web; bila tidak tersedia -> skenario MANUAL
assertionRules.routes: ASM-30 — seluruh route deep-link adalah usulan kebab-case; wajib diparameterisasi lewat fixture
assertionRules.propagation: ASM-37 — page.reload() setelah PATCH sebelum assert menu; logout-login untuk skenario ketat; tanpa refresh = menu lama boleh tetap tampil
assertionRules.absenceAssertion: ASM-31 — toHaveCount(0), bukan not.toBeVisible(); guard = 403 ATAU redirect (assertion OR) + konten fitur wajib absen
assertionRules.selectorPriority: ASM-22/ASM-23 — getByRole+name (regex CI) -> getByTestId -> getByLabel -> teks parsial CI; testid nav dua kandidat nav-item-<slug> | nav-<slug>
assertionRules.cardinality: angka absolut hanya untuk REQ-050 (6), REQ-067 (8), REQ-068 (2)
assertionRules.collapsibleGroup: ASM-25 — buka grup MASTER OPERASIONAL sebelum assert anaknya
